note: [L] gives two-sided bounds with one uniform numeric error E (4.25e-7 x) for all non-principal characters and 2.83e-7 x for the principal one, not the explicit q*|err_chi|^2 x^2, ET(2|eta|_1+ET) and K_{q,2} x terms; eta_+ only, q-tilde <= 3e5, x >= 4.9e26.

snippet.text:
/-- **[H, §10.3] for one modulus `q`** (`q̃ ≤ 3·10⁵`, `|βx| ≤ 1.2·10⁶/q̃`, `x ≥ 4.9·10²⁶`), with
`S'_q = Σ_{(n,q)=1} Λ(n) η₊(n/x) e(nα)`:
`μ²(q)/φ(q) |S'_q(β)|² ≤ Σ_b |S'_q(b/q + β)|² ≤ μ²(q)/φ(q) |S'_q(β)|² + (4.25·10⁻⁷ x)²` and
`|S'_q(β) − η̂₊(−βx) x| ≤ 2.83·10⁻⁷ x`. -/
theorem arc_chars {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) {q : ℕ} (hq1 : 1 ≤ q) (hqt : (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 300000)
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : |β * x| ≤ 1200000 / qt q) :
    ((if Squarefree q then (1:ℝ) else 0) / q.totient * ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) β‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) ((b : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) ((b : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (if Squarefree q then (1:ℝ) else 0) / q.totient * ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) β‖ ^ 2 +
          (4.25e-7 * x) ^ 2) ∧
      ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) β - 𝓕 etaPC (-(β * x)) * x‖ ≤ 2.83e-7 * x := by

proof_context.conclusion: For the coprime part $S'_q$ of $S_{\eta_+}$: $\frac{\mu^2(q)}{\phi(q)}|S'_q(\beta)|^2\le\sum_b|S'_q(b/q+\beta)|^2\le\frac{\mu^2(q)}{\phi(q)}|S'_q(\beta)|^2+(4.25\cdot10^{-7}x)^2$ and $|S'_q(\beta)-\widehat{\eta_+}(-\beta x)x|\le2.83\cdot10^{-7}x$.
